moc.chu: Apollo 8 was launched at 12:51:00 UTC (7:51 am EST) on December 21, 1968, using the Saturn V's three stages to achieve Earth orbit.
Anders saw the Earth emerging from behind the lunar horizon and called in excitement to the others, taking a black-and-white photograph as he did so.
Anders (laughing): You got a color film, Jim?
The spacecraft began its journey back to Earth on December 25, Christmas Day.
Fifty years to the day after taking the photo, William Anders observed, "We set out to explore the moon and instead discovered the Earth."
